steps.content:
09:00, August 8, N.F. 113
FAC Memorial Cemetery
West District Combat Casualty Memorial Service

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Today, we gather here to honor our 1423 warriors, friends, and fellow citizens.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: In the March catastrophe, they selflessly rushed to the West District, sacrificing their lives to combat the sudden outbreak of Mania.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Now that the disaster has been contained, the call to counterattack is ready to sound, and FAC can finally return them to their loved ones.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Thank you for coming, to bid our heroes their final farewell.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.content: My child, did you come alone? Where is your family? Ah... I shouldn't have asked...

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.content: I'm sorry, it must be hard for you... Sigh...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Thank you... I'm here on behalf of someone else, it's okay.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'll be strong.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: A memorial? Heh, it's enough that you go. Aren't you also their "daughter"? Even if you're adopted, they loved you more.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: I won't go.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: This era is riddled with scars, the nights are long, and the path is unclear. But there are always those who believe, who stand and fight for the city-state they deeply love, and sacrifice for the future they firmly believe in.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: They are the heroes who guard the light in darkness, the warriors who reclaim hope in despair. We will never forget.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: And for you, our heroes have returned.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: ...What... do you want to comfort me? Or is it... you want my comfort?

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: Just because my parents died, you think we're finally the same, that we can sympathize with each other?

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: This cemetery was built for you and also for them. They hope you will come because they long to see their loved ones safe.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Please visit them often. Seeing you safe and sound is the greatest meaning of every FAC battle.

steps.speaker: Miserable Girl
steps.content: Get lost! I'm not like you, I don't buy into FAC's crap, I don't recognize these kinds of heroes!

steps.speaker: Miserable Girl
steps.content: They're dead, that's all there is to it. They left me behind, made me an orphan too! What kind of heroes are they?!

steps.speaker: Miserable Girl
steps.content: Sob... screw light and justice... dying for these nonsensical ideas... You're all idiots, all of you...

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...Thank you for coming.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: May our city-state be free from suffering, may our fellow citizens be forever safe.
A soft Blue Rain falls. The FAC memorial service always has this apt atmosphere, both to purify the BR-002 contamination that has spread throughout the city and to mourn the fallen heroes.
Christina leaves the cemetery, finds a secluded spot, puts away her umbrella, and looks up at the sky.
Blue Rain hits her face, gathering in streaks, mixing with tears sliding down her cheeks, tracing the marks of Mania stress. How she wishes this pain could bring her clarity.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Hold onto light... believe... in justice...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I will... I'm strong...
The ring of her phone suddenly interrupts. She absent-mindedly takes out her mobile, but as she recognizes the familiar melody, her dull eyes suddenly light up. She jumps in an instant.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Shalom! You're back!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Oh... you've been so busy... I thought...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What?! Those Underground guys are causing trouble again? Another series of attacks by Garden Assassins? Despicable! They can't win on the battlefield, so they resort to dirty tricks behind our backs.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Huh? You want me to be a special investigator?! Really?!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yes, yes, of course I'll do it! I will do my best to complete the mission that you gave me. I swear on the name of the <size=25><color=#7683a2>future</color></size> great detective Christina, I will set off right now!
She hangs up the call and starts to dash. She leaps three feet high after taking a few steps.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Shalom is counting on me! For light and justice!

On August 8, N.F. 113, FAC Commander-in-Chief leaves the West District combat frontline and returns to Eastside, formally submitting the <color=#fb9259>"BR-002 Black Ring Blockade Operation"</color> authorization application to the City Council. The intention is to build a counter-Mania shield around BR-002 to limit the spread of Black Ring contamination and completely stabilize the West District environment.


The establishment of FAC is to protect DisCity. The West District is a part of Dis, and the people of the West District are DisCitizens who should be protected.


They should not be abandoned.

The operation has initially gained the support of Paradeisos. The specifics of funding, manpower, organizational authority, and other matters will be jointly evaluated by representatives including Nirvana, and the final review will be completed on <color=#fb9259>August 15</color>.
